title: The Drowned Declaration
intro: Picture a mighty ruler surrounded by splendor, monuments, and armies obedient to a single command. This figure claimed supreme authority, dismissed divine signs as illusion, and ordered a relentless pursuit toward the sea. Follow the trail from arrogant decrees to parted waters, where a final confession arrives too late to save.
clues: I held absolute power and enslaved the Children of Israel beneath my rule.
I declared myself the most high lord and refused to acknowledge any god above me.
I commanded Haman to build me a lofty tower that I might look at the God of Musa.
I confronted Musa and Harun when they brought clear signs, and I called their miracles sorcery.
I pursued Musa and the believers with my armies by night until we reached the sea.
I declared belief while drowning in the sea, but it was too late, and my body was preserved as a sign.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Was thrown into a fire that became cool and safe
Built an ark to survive a great flood
Slept in a cave with companions for many years
Was swallowed by a great fish in the depths
Drowned while pursuing Musa and the Israelites through the parted sea
trial.answer: Drowned while pursuing Musa and the Israelites through the parted sea

location.label: Key Element
options: The belly of the great fish

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Forgiven and granted a long peaceful reign
Swallowed by the earth with treasures
Drowned in disbelief and body preserved as a sign for those after
outcome.answer: Drowned in disbelief and body preserved as a sign for those after

arabic: ءَآلْـَٔـٰنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verse: Now? And you had disobeyed [Him] before and were of the corrupters? (10:91)
